 # Return the standardized hospital ownership type
 cleaned_value

# Define a pattern to match common variations of hospital ownership types
pattern = r'(voluntary|government|proprietary|church|private|other) (non-profit|- non-profit| - private| - church| - other)'

def standardize_hospital_ownership(value):
    # Use re.sub to replace the matched pattern with a consistent spelling and capitalization
    return re.sub(pattern, lambda x: x.group(1).title(), value)

# Apply the function to each row in the HospitalOwner column
data = [
    'voluntary non-profit - private',
    'PROPRIETARY',
    'proprietary',
    'GOVERNMENT_-_HOSPITAL_DISTRICT_OR_AUTHORITY',
    'GOVERNMENT_-_HOSPITAL_DISTRICT_OR_AUTHORITY',
    'VOLUNTARY_NON-PROFIT_-_CHURCH',
    'proprietary',
    'VOLUNTARY NON-PROFIT - PRIVATE',
    'PROPRIETARY',
    'PROPRIETARY',
    'VOLUNTARY NON-PROFIT Z CHURCH',
    'VOLUNTARY NON-PROFIT - OTHER',
    'GOVERNMENT - STATE',
    'GOVERNMENT - HOSPITAL DISTRICT OR AUTHORITY',
    'PROPRIESARY',
    'GOVERNMENT - FEDERAL',
    'voluntary non-profit - other',
    'PROPRIETARY',
    'VOLUNTARY NON-PROFIT - PRILATE',
    'voluntary non-profit - church'
]

standardized_data = [standardize_hospital_ownership(row) for row in data]
return value
